All tests pass. I implemented `Recite` in bottle_song.go:

- **`bottleNames`** maps 0–10 to their spelled-out forms (`no`, `one`, … `ten`), covering both the verse count and the remaining count.
- **`bottleWord`** handles the singular/plural rule — `one green bottle`, but `no green bottles` and everything else plural.
- **`titleCase`** capitalizes the first letter of the verse count (`Ten`, `Three`, …), matching the lyrics.
- **`Recite`** loops from `startBottles` down, emitting each 4-line verse and inserting a blank line (`""`) between verses, exactly as the expected outputs in cases_test.go require.

`go test ./...` → `ok bottlesong`. No other files were touched.
